description_en: Replaces a file in the workspace resources
description_zh: 替换协作空间资料文件
name: ReplaceGroupSourceFile

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this parameter explicitly by using `--tenant-id`
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 `--tenant-id` 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for re-parsing to complete. Default value: false, which means the task is asynchronously enqueued
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步等待重新解析完成；默认 false，异步入队
parameters.name: force_sync

parameters.help_en: The OSS persistent storage path of the replacement file
parameters.help_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The OSS persistent storage path of the replacement file
parameters.help_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址
parameters.name: file_public_url

parameters.help_en: The file record ID of the replacement file
parameters.help_zh: 替换后的文件记录 ID
parameters.name: file_record_id

parameters.help_en: The new file name. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter or set it to an empty string, the original file name is retained
parameters.help_zh: 新文件名（可选；不传或空字符串时保持原文件名）
parameters.name: file_name

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A failure returns a backend error code (ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*)
code.description_zh: 业务状态码：成功为 200，失败为后端错误码（ERR.* / InvalidParameter.*）

filePath.description_en: The OSS persistent storage path of the replacement file
filePath.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

filePublicUrl.description_en: The OSS persistent storage path of the replacement file
filePublicUrl.description_zh: 替换后的文件 OSS 持久化地址

fileRecordId.description_en: The file record ID of the replacement file
fileRecordId.description_zh: 替换后的文件记录 ID

message.description_en: The description of the status code
message.example: The current zone list is illegal.

sourceType.description_en: The data source type. The value is fixed as FILE
sourceType.description_zh: 数据源类型，固定为 FILE

status.description_en:
The data source status. Valid values:
1: Online.
0: Offline
status.description_zh:
数据源状态，取值：
1：上线
0：下线
